<!-- GENERATED by scripts/gen-api-reference.ts from sdk/openapi.json. Do not edit — including in Studio; the next build replaces this file. -->

::api-operation{method="DELETE" path="/v1/businesses/{biz}/emails/templates/{type}"}
#docs
Returns the built-in that now applies.

## Path parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `biz` | `string` | **yes** | Business id (biz_…) |
| `type` | `string` | **yes** | Billing email type |

## Headers

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `Idempotency-Key` | `string` | no | Safely retry writes — repeats return the original response. If a write FAILED after it had already taken effect, that failure is what repeats: the key is spent, and a new attempt needs a new key. |

## Response

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `object` | `string` | The object type; always `email_template`. One of `email_template`. |
| `id` | `string` | Null when this is the built-in — no override row exists. |
| `type` | `string` | The email type this template is for. |
| `subject` | `string` | The subject line of the email. |
| `heading` | `string` | The heading at the top of the email. |
| `body` | `string` | The body text of the email. |
| `footer` | `string` | This email's own footer, same syntax and HTML subset as body. Null or empty uses the business footer (`email_config.footerNote`), else the built-in one. |
| `cta_label` | `string` | Button text override. Null keeps `default_cta_label`. |
| `show_facts` | `boolean` | False hides the facts card. |
| `block_order` | `array of string` | Order of the movable sections, each exactly once. Null = body, action, facts, footer. |
| `default_cta_label` | `string` | The engine's button label; null when this email never has a button. |
| `has_facts` | `boolean` | Whether this email ever has a facts card. |
| `default_footer` | `string` | What a null `footer` uses: the business footer (`email_config.footerNote`), else the built-in one. |
| `built_in` | `object` | The built-in subject, heading and body, for resetting a draft to the default. |
| `customized` | `boolean` | False = the built-in. Improvements to built-ins reach these businesses automatically. |
| `variables` | `array of object` | Merge variables the engine populates for this type. |
| `attachments` | `object` | This business's attachment rule for this email: business config, not template wording, changed through `email_config.attachments`. Null when the email is about no document. |
| `updated_at` | `string · ISO-8601` | When the email template was last changed (ISO-8601 UTC). |

## Status codes

| Status | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `200` | Reset |
| `400` | Unknown email type |
| `409` | Idempotency-Key conflict — the key is already in flight, or was reused with a different request payload. |

#request
```bash [Request]
curl -X DELETE "$TMBILLING_URL/v1/businesses/biz_XXXXXXXXXXXX01/emails/templates/invoice_issued" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TMBILLING_API_KEY" \
  -H "Idempotency-Key: $(uuidgen)"
```
